fields.name: iPhone 15 Pro Max

Samsung's flagship comes with a built-in S Pen, a titanium frame and Galaxy AI tools for live translation, note summaries and smarter photo editing.

fields.name: MacBook Pro 16 M3

fields.name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon

fields.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14

• 14-inch high-refresh-rate display

fields.name: MSI Creator Z16

fields.name: Xbox Series X
